title: Reflection atlas leaks 7 texture RIDs per Scenario (`color_buffer` and `color_views` are never freed)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.stable, 4.7.1.stable, master (`00932449c9`)
- Not reproducible in: 4.5.stable

| renderer | result |
|---|---|
| Forward+ | leaks |
| Forward Mobile | leaks |
| Compatibility | clean |

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot v4.6.stable / v4.7.1.stable / master (`00932449c9`) - Vulkan 1.4.349 - AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT

### Issue description

### Issue description

Once a `ReflectionProbe` has rendered, seven texture RIDs belonging to the
reflection atlas are never freed — not when the atlas is cleared and rebuilt
during play, and not when the `Scenario` that owns it is freed. A project with a
single probe ends with:

```
WARNING: 7 RIDs of type "Texture" were leaked.
   at: finalize (servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp:8900)
```

It is not a constant, and it is not confined to shutdown. The count scales with
the number of atlases the process has ever built:

| scenario | leaked at exit |
|---|---|
| one probe, one world | 7 |
| one probe, then switched to `UPDATE_ALWAYS` (rebuilds the atlas mid-run) | 14 |
| four `World3D`s, each with a probe, each freed during play | 28 |

The four worlds are created and dropped one at a time, so at no point do four
atlases exist at once — each freed world leaves its seven textures behind.

### Root cause

`LightStorage::_reflection_atlas_update()` creates the cubemap the probe renders
into, plus a slice view per face:

```cpp
atlas->color_buffer = RD::get_singleton()->texture_create(tf, RD::TextureView());   // TEXTURE_TYPE_CUBE
...
for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    atlas->color_views[i] = RD::get_singleton()->texture_create_shared_from_slice(
            RD::TextureView(), atlas->color_buffer, i, 0);
    atlas->color_fbs[i] = ...->reflection_probe_create_framebuffer(atlas->color_views[i], atlas->depth_buffer);
}
```

`LightStorage::_reflection_atlas_clear()` frees `reflection`, `depth_fb` and
`depth_buffer`, but neither `color_buffer` nor `color_views`. Those two fields
are never passed to `free_rid()` anywhere in the engine — searching
`color_buffer|color_views` in `light_storage.cpp` only finds the lines that
create and use them. Since `reflection_atlas_free()` goes through
`reflection_atlas_set_size(atlas, 0, 0)` → `_reflection_atlas_clear()`, freeing
the whole atlas does not release them either.

1 cubemap + 6 slice views = the 7 per atlas.

`color_fbs[6]` does get freed, which is why there is no matching "Framebuffer"
warning: those framebuffers are dependents of `depth_buffer`, and
RenderingDevice frees dependents along with it.

Both fields were added by #107902 ("Rewrite Radiance and Reflection probes to use
Octahedral maps", milestone 4.6), which introduced the cubemap→octmap copy step;
they were not added to the teardown path. That matches 4.5 being clean.

### Steps to reproduce

1. New project, Forward+ or Mobile.
2. Main scene: `Node3D` with a `Camera3D` and a `ReflectionProbe`.
3. Run it and close it.

The MRP below does this without interaction, and contains a second scene
(`worlds.tscn`) that builds and drops four worlds to show the leak scaling.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/ravarcade/godot-reflection-probe-rid-leak

[godot-reflection-probe-rid-leak-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31115705/godot-reflection-probe-rid-leak-mrp.zip)
